screen.nyanlex.warmup.warn.1: In the background, the name and full tooltip of every registered item is sent for translation, filling each batch as far as it goes. Items that are already saved, and items whose name and text are already in the target language, are skipped.
screen.nyanlex.warmup.warn.2: This is fast: up to 3 batches are in flight at once, so your AI quota is used up in a short time and may cost money. Free quotas can hit 429 rate limits quickly, and a 429 pauses chat and tooltip translation for a while too (when rate limited, pre-translation drops back to one batch at a time and pauses).
screen.nyanlex.warmup.warn.3: Only covers items registered by mods, so it suits modpacks. Items and content added by servers are not included.
screen.nyanlex.warmup.warn.4: You can pause or stop at any time; to carry on later, press Continue yourself. Pre-translation never starts by itself: not when the game launches, not when you enter a world, not on the next launch. What is already saved is skipped. While chat, tooltip or manual translation is working, pre-translation holds back so those go first.
screen.nyanlex.warmup.last: Last time it stopped at %s / %s; Continue picks up from there and skips what is already saved.

nyanlex.manual.title: Manual
nyanlex.settings.manual.tip: Quick setup, display and translation service, hotkeys, online translation and privacy.
nyanlex.manual.s1.title: Getting started
nyanlex.manual.s1.body:
The first time you reach the title screen, the setup helper appears by itself and asks a few simple questions to set your translation language, how to translate and how text is shown. Nothing you choose is applied, and nothing is sent, until you press Done.
To run it again later, open "Translation settings > General > Quick setup", or press the button at the top of this page.
nyanlex.manual.s2.title: What can be translated
nyanlex.manual.s2.body: Chat, item tooltips, scoreboards, nameplates, boss bars, titles, the action bar, books and screen text can all be translated. Each one can be set to off, bilingual (original + translation) or translation (translation only).
nyanlex.manual.s3.title: Display and service
nyanlex.manual.s3.body:
The Display category has one row per item with two buttons: the left one cycles Off, bilingual, translation; the right one switches the translation service, machine translation or AI. The "All items" row at the top sets every item at once; when the items differ it reads "Mixed".
Machine translation (Google, unofficial endpoint) works with no setup, but only chat is translated automatically; everything else waits for the hotkey. AI translates more naturally and translates everything automatically; first enter an API key in the Translation service category, or sign in to ChatGPT (which uses your account's Codex quota). Your API key is stored only on your computer and is never uploaded.
The key-free Google endpoint is sometimes limited for a while; the mod pauses automatically and retries later.
When AI fails for a moment, machine translation can fill in so the screen does not stay on the original text.
nyanlex.manual.s4.title: Items and screen text
nyanlex.manual.s4.body:
Everything except chat (item tooltips, the held item name, container and hotbar item names, the scoreboard, name tags, boss bars, titles, the action bar, books and mod screen text) follows the translation service you picked for it: with AI it translates automatically like chat; with machine translation it is manual, so joining a server never floods it with text, and anything already translated (AI translations, translation packs, saved machine translations) keeps showing.
On machine translation: press {R} to translate the item under the cursor or in your hand; press {P} with a screen open to translate that whole screen (an open book counts as a screen); press {P} with no screen open, in the world, to translate the scoreboard, name tags, boss bars, titles and action bar you can see, sent as one batch. While "Online translation" is off, pressing them first asks whether to start: only after you agree is anything sent and the action completed; cancel sends nothing.
nyanlex.manual.s5.title: Hotkeys
nyanlex.manual.s5.body:
{R}Translate the item under the cursor; with no screen open, translate the item in your hand.
{P}Translate the whole screen that is open; with no screen open, translate the scoreboard, name tags, boss bars, titles and action bar you can see.
{G}Switch between the original and the translation.
{S}Open the translation settings. Not bound by default.
To use keys that suit you, open "Translation settings > General > Hotkeys", or use the game's Controls screen. The key caps here show the keys you actually bound.
nyanlex.manual.s6.title: Online translation and privacy
nyanlex.manual.s6.body:
"Online translation" decides whether any text is sent ("Translation settings > General"). It is off on a fresh install: nothing is sent until you press Done or agree to start. While it is off, saved translations, downloaded packs and the built-in name list still show.
What is sent: the text of the items you turned translation on for, chat included (possibly private messages and player names); an item set to Off sends nothing.
Where it goes: the translation service you picked. Machine translation goes to Google Translate (unofficial endpoint); AI goes to the service you set up in the Translation service category; signing in with ChatGPT uses your account's Codex quota.
How to stop: turn off "Online translation". Your API key stays on your computer only and is never uploaded.
nyanlex.manual.s7.title: Translation packs
nyanlex.manual.s7.body:
A translation pack is a ready-made translation that someone prepared and you can simply download. At the end of the quick setup it checks whether your installed mods have one; later you can press "Detect" under "Translation settings > Translation packs".
The list shows names and sizes and downloads only after you confirm. Only public translation packs are fetched; nothing of yours is uploaded.
nyanlex.manual.s8.title: Pre-translate all items
nyanlex.manual.s8.body:
Under "Translation settings > My translations" you can translate every item name and description in one go. It works from the title screen, no world needed; a few mod items need a world to build their tooltip, are skipped and counted; press Start again inside a world to fill them in. Nothing re-runs by itself.
It needs the AI service; if items use machine translation right now, the button reads "Switch to AI..." and takes you to Translation service. While "Online translation" is off you are asked before it starts. After you start it you return to the screen you came from; it runs in the background with progress in the screen corner, and you can pause or stop it any time. It only runs after you press Start or Continue: launching the game or entering a world never starts it, and a pause lasts until you press Continue (only a rate limit, once it lifts, carries on by itself, and only inside the same run). When the last run did not finish, the card shows where it stopped and the button reads Continue.
The same category exports and imports your saved translations, or clears the saved translations of the current language.
nyanlex.manual.s9.title: Hints and notifications
nyanlex.manual.s9.body:
In game, the result of pressing {R}, {P} or {G} appears briefly in the action bar above the hotbar, no longer in chat.
Results of things you do on the title screen or in menus, such as importing, exporting, downloading translation packs or finishing pre-translation, arrive as a notification at the top right.
While pre-translation runs, its progress shows in the screen corner: top left in game, top right in menus.
The little hint at the bottom of an item tooltip only appears when pressing the hotkey would actually do something.
Debug mode (Translation settings > Advanced), when on, shows the translation status in the screen corner and logs errors, and only errors, to a local debug log (the newest 1,000 entries; API keys are masked) that you can attach when reporting a problem.
nyanlex.manual.s10.title: About
nyanlex.settings.quick.tip: A few simple questions to set your language, how to translate and how text is shown. You can run it again whenever you like.
nyanlex.setup.title: Quick setup
nyanlex.setup.welcome.title: Welcome to NyanLex Translator
nyanlex.setup.welcome.body: The setup helper walks you through a few simple choices so the text in the game turns into a language you understand.
nyanlex.setup.welcome.note: You can change every one of these later under "Translation settings".
nyanlex.setup.lang.title: Which language should game text be translated into?
nyanlex.setup.lang.follow.desc: When the game language changes, the translation language changes with it.
nyanlex.setup.lang.other.desc: Pick one from the language list, whatever the game language is.
nyanlex.setup.method.title: How would you like to translate?
nyanlex.setup.method.machine.desc: Works with no setup. Only chat is translated automatically; everything else (items, screens, the scoreboard, boss bars, titles) is translated when you press a hotkey: %s translates an item; %s translates the screen that is open, or, in the world, the scoreboard, boss bars and titles on screen. Text is sent to Google Translate (unofficial endpoint).
nyanlex.setup.method.ai.desc: More natural translations, and all text is translated automatically. Needs your own API key, or a ChatGPT sign-in (which uses your account's Codex quota).
nyanlex.setup.method.none.desc: Keep online translation off. Only translations you already have are shown, and no text is sent.
nyanlex.setup.method.note: Only the text you set to be translated is sent; you can turn "Online translation" off in the settings at any time.
nyanlex.setup.display.title: How should translations be shown?
nyanlex.setup.display.chat.note: When chat is translated, chat messages (private messages included) are sent for translation.
nyanlex.setup.packs.title: %s of your installed mods have a ready-made translation pack (%s in total). Download them now?
nyanlex.setup.packs.skipped: Alright. You can download them any time under "Translation settings > Translation packs".
nyanlex.setup.packs.note: Only public translation packs are downloaded; nothing of yours is uploaded.
nyanlex.setup.done.title: All set!
nyanlex.setup.done.keys: Remember these three hotkeys and you are good to go:
nyanlex.setup.done.key.item: Translate the item under the cursor; with no screen open, translate the item in your hand
nyanlex.setup.done.key.screen: Translate the open screen; in the world, the scoreboard, boss bars and titles on screen
nyanlex.setup.done.key.toggle: Switch between the original and the translation
nyanlex.setup.done.rebind: Keys not comfortable? Change them under "Translation settings > General > Hotkeys".
nyanlex.setup.done.menu: To adjust anything else later: press Esc > Options > Translation settings...
nyanlex.setup.done.downloading: Translation packs are downloading in the background; you will be notified when they are done.
nyanlex.setup.done.note: The rest of the details are in the manual, for the night you cannot sleep.
